items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Somebody called me up, Antoinette Handy, called me up and she said, “I been looking for you for four weeks.”

ctx.x: American Jazz Master Award from the National Endowment for the Arts, 1992. An honor for you? You’re smiling, tell me about that.
Somebody called me up, Antoinette Handy, called me up and she said, “I been looking for you for four weeks.” So I said, “Do I owe you money?” She said, “No, I have
something to give you.” I started crying. She said, “We got $20,000 for you.” I said, “Ohhhh, Ohhh.” She said, “It’s true.” So, that’s how I got that.
